convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (Color3rdGenXMA) and external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and money management. Multiple margin modes and complex position sizing require manual conversion.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation
UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar end
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar end

other_exits: Time-based exit: positions closed after TimeMin (720 minutes) holding period via CloseCheck()
Signal-based exit: BuyPosClose/SellPosClose flags allow closing on opposite indicator signals (disabled by default)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum: FREEMARGIN (share of free funds), BALANCE (share of balance), LOSSFREEMARGIN (loss share of free funds), LOSSBALANCE (loss share of balance), LOT (fixed lot). Default LOT mode uses MM=0.1 as fixed lot size; other modes use MM as share/fraction of account.

custom_logic_notes: Signal is read from Color3rdGenXMA buffer 1: value 2 = uptrend (buy signal), value 0 = downtrend (sell signal), value 1 presumably = neutral/no signal. Entry is gated by exact hour:minute match (StartHour:StartMinute), so trades only open at one specific minute per day. The signal persists intrabar (BUY_Open1/SELL_Open1 stay true) but only triggers at the configured time. Time-based forced exit after 720 minutes (12 hours). CloseCheck() forces exit of any open position exceeding the hold time. BuyPosClose and SellPosClose default to false, meaning signal-reversal closing is disabled by default.
python_conversion_notes: The Color3rdGenXMA custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python or its buffer values pre-computed and fed as data. The SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library contains 10+ smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA) - these are non-trivial to replicate. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with 5 margin modes; these must be reimplemented. The time-gated entry (single minute per day) is unusual and must be preserved. The SignalBar=1 default means signals are read from the previous completed bar. For backtesting, the indicator's buffer 1 color values (0/1/2) must be reconstructed from the 3rd-generation XMA calculations.
